Item # 1: Researchers published the results of their trial showing that treating the kidney with radio waves can significantly reduce high blood pressure.
Item # 2: A new study suggests that drinking very hot tea increases the risk of breast cancer in women.
Item # 3: American researchers are developing a system that fights mosquitoes by targeting and shooting them with lasers.
